QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Daidarabotchi's Second Message
QuestInfo.0: Kino Konoko sends you another message. She tells you that she received another vision from Daidarabotchi...
QuestInfo.1: Daidarabotchi's message was to defeat the Oni disrupting the lifeforce of Kamuna and collect the Metal Element. Go to #m800021000# and investigate the truth. You can get to #m800021000# from #m800010000#.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in #m800021000# but there weren't any Oni there. What happened here?
